provenance.note: Pinned qlib v0.9.6 model kwargs; explicit model seeds and corrected label processing. No tuning.

data_convention.features: clean CSI300 panel (Alpha158 columns) as consumed by every arm. Per-model feature sets follow the official v0.9.6 yamls: LSTM/GRU/ALSTM/Transformer configs specify FilterCol col_list (20 columns, verbatim below); XGBoost and DoubleEnsemble configs specify NO FilterCol and therefore use the full 158-column Alpha158 handler. No extra infer processors (the clean panel is already the W1-verified processed input: RobustZScoreNorm fit 2008-01-01..train_end, fillna(0)).
data_convention.label: NN: CSRankNorm over label_mask_r1 per date, (rank(pct=True)-0.5)*3.46. XGB/DE: CSZScoreNorm = z_r1.
data_convention.seed_policy: Explicit model seeds 1,2,3. Existing effective-seed-0 XGB/Transformer artefacts remain descriptive.

LSTM.feature_processing_official: RobustZScoreNorm fit on official training window; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; model-specific FilterCol
LSTM.feature_processing_ours: RobustZScoreNorm fit 2008-2018; clip +/-3; Fillna 0; VWAP0 set to 0; model-specific FilterCol
LSTM.seed_policy: Explicit model seeds 1,2,3. Existing effective-seed-0 XGB/Transformer artefacts remain descriptive.

reported_edge_caution: Qlib's published benchmark numbers use train 2008-2014 / valid 2015-2016 / test 2017-2020-08 and the qlib data handler; any comparison to published IC/excess must state the different windows and pipeline (this study: clean panel, train 2008-2018, valid 2019-2020, rule selection 2021-2022).
